description_en: Retrieves the details of a multi-zone instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeMultiZoneCluster可以获取多可用区实例的详情信息
name: DescribeMultiZoneCluster

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multi-zone instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html to obtain the list. The multi-zone instance has DbType set to hbaseue and ModuleStackVersion set to 2.0
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例的Id，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html获取列表，列表中**DbType**为hbaseue且**ModuleStackVersion**为2.0的多可用区实例
parameters.name: cluster_id

ArbiterVSwitchIds.description_en: The vSwitch ID of the arbiter zone

ArbiterZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the arbiter zone

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the multi-zone instance when PayType is set to Prepaid. Valid values:
True: Auto-renewal is enabled.
False: Auto-renewal is disabled
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
对于PayType为预付费（Prepaid）的多可用区实例，有此是否自动续费字段。
True：自动续费。
False：不自动续费

ColdStorageSize.description_en: The cold storage size. Unit: GB

CoreDiskCount.description_en: The number of core node disks

CoreDiskSize.description_en: The disk size of a core node. Unit: GB

CoreDiskType.description_en:
The disk type of core nodes. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
local_hdd_pro: throughput-intensive local disk.
local_ssd_pro: I/O-intensive local disk
CoreDiskType.description_zh:
core磁盘类型：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD盘。
local_hdd_pro：吞吐密集型本地盘。
local_ssd_pro：I/O密集型本地盘

CoreInstanceType.description_en: The node specifications of core nodes

CoreNodeCount.description_en: The number of core nodes. The minimum value is 4, and the increment is a multiple of 2
CoreNodeCount.description_zh: core节点个数，4节点起，且增量为2的倍数

CreatedTime.description_en: The creation time in the current time zone
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建时间，当前时区的时间

Duration.description_en:
The Unified Auto Renewal Cycle. This parameter is not returned for pay-as-you-go instances.
Monthly subscription: The auto-renewal epoch is 1 month.
Yearly subscription: The auto-renewal epoch is 1 year (12 months)
Duration.description_zh:
自动续费周期，后付费实例无此返回值。
按月购买：则自动续费周期为1 个月。
按年购买：则自动续费周期为1 年（12个月）

EncryptionKey.description_en:
The ID of the encryption key. This parameter is empty if encryption is not enabled.

Cloud disk encryption cannot be disabled after it is enabled
EncryptionKey.description_zh:
加密的密钥ID，如果未启用加密则为空。

当前云盘加密开启后无法关闭

EncryptionType.description_en:
The encryption type. Valid values:

NULL: Encryption is not enabled. This is the default value.

CloudDisk: Cloud disk encryption. The encryption key is specified by the EncryptionKey parameter
EncryptionType.description_zh:
加密类型，可选项为：

NULL：不启用加密（默认值）。

CloudDisk：云盘加密并通过EncryptionKey参数指定密钥

Engine.description_en: The service type. Currently, only hbaseue is supported

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time in the current time zone. This parameter is returned only when PayType is set to Prepaid
ExpireTime.description_zh: 过期时间，预付费（PayType为Prepaid）时有此字段（当前时区）

ExpireTimeUTC.description_en: The expiration time in UTC. This parameter is returned only when PayType is set to Prepaid
ExpireTimeUTC.description_zh: 过期时间，预付费（PayType为Prepaid）时有此字段（UTC时间）

IsDeletionProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether deletion protection is enabled. Valid values:
True: Deletion protection is enabled. The instance cannot be deleted. An error message is returned if you attempt to delete the instance.
False: Deletion protection is disabled. The instance can be deleted
IsDeletionProtection.description_zh:
是否启动删除保护：
True：启动，不能删除，删除时会提示禁止删除。
False：不启动，可以删除

LogDiskCount.description_en: The number of disks per log node

LogDiskSize.description_en: The size of a single disk on a log node. Unit: GB
LogDiskSize.description_zh: log节点单个磁盘大小，单位：GB

LogDiskType.description_en:
The disk type of log nodes. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
local_hdd_pro: throughput-intensive local disk.
local_ssd_pro: I/O-intensive local disk
LogDiskType.description_zh:
log节点磁盘类型。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD盘。
local_hdd_pro：吞吐密集型本地盘。
local_ssd_pro：I/O密集型本地盘

LogInstanceType.description_en: The node specifications of log nodes. You can call [DescribeInstanceType]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html） to query the exact information
LogInstanceType.description_zh: log节点规格， 可以从[DescribeInstanceType]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html）接口查询到准确的信息

LogNodeCount.description_en: The number of log nodes. The minimum value is 4, and the value must be a multiple of 4
LogNodeCount.description_zh: log节点数量，4节点起，且为4的倍数

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the O&M window. The format is HH:MMZ, such as 20:00Z
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 可运维时间结束时间。HH:MMZ样式，如20:00Z

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the O&M window. The format is HH:MMZ, such as 20:00Z
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 可运维时间开始时间。HH:MMZ样式，如20:00Z

MajorVersion.description_en: The major version based on the engine type. Currently, only version 2.0 of hbaseue is supported
MajorVersion.description_zh: 根据引擎类型的版本号，目前仅支持hbaseue的2.0版本

MasterDiskSize.description_en: The disk size of master nodes

MasterDiskType.description_en: The disk type of master nodes

MasterInstanceType.description_en: The node specifications of master nodes

MultiZoneCombination.description_en: The zone combination of the multi-zone instance
MultiZoneCombination.description_zh: 当前多可用区实例的可用区组合

MultiZoneInstanceModel.description_en: The information about instances in each zone of the multi-zone instance
MultiZoneInstanceModel.description_zh: 该多可用区实例下各个可用区实例信息

HdfsMinorVersion.description_en: The current version number of the storage engine

IsHdfsLatestVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the storage engine is the latest version
IsHdfsLatestVersion.description_zh: 存储引擎是否是最新版本

IsLatestVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the instance is the latest version

LatestHdfsMinorVersion.description_en: The latest version number of the storage engine
LatestHdfsMinorVersion.description_zh: 存储引擎当前最新版本号

LatestMinorVersion.description_en: The latest version of the wide table engine
LatestMinorVersion.description_zh: 宽表引擎当前的最新版本

MinorVersion.description_en: The minor version number of the instance

NetworkType.description_en: The network type. Currently, only VPC is supported

ParentId.description_en: The instance ID of the primary instance. This parameter is returned only when the instance is a component instance
ParentId.description_zh: 如果为组件实例，会有此字段显示其主实例ID

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型。
Prepaid：预付费。
Postpaid：后付费

PrimaryVSwitchIds.description_en: The vSwitch ID of the primary zone instance
PrimaryVSwitchIds.description_zh: 主可用区实例的虚拟交换机ID

PrimaryZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the primary zone instance
PrimaryZoneId.description_zh: 主可用区实例的可用区ID

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the resource belongs

StandbyVSwitchIds.description_en: The vSwitch ID of the secondary zone instance
StandbyVSwitchIds.description_zh: 备可用区实例的虚拟交换机ID

StandbyZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the secondary zone instance
StandbyZoneId.description_zh: 备可用区实例的可用区ID

Status.description_en:
The cluster status. Valid values:
CREATING: The cluster is being created.
ACTIVATION: The cluster is running.
DELETING: The cluster is being deleted.
RESTARTING: The cluster is being restarted
Status.description_zh:
集群状态。
CREATING：创建中。
ACTIVATION：运行中。
DELETING：删除中。
RESTARTING：重启中

TaskProgress.description_en: The progress of the task running on the instance, in percentage (%). Tasks initiated from the ApsaraDB for HBase console include specification changes, node scale-out, node scale-in, instance restart, and minor engine version update
TaskProgress.description_zh: 实例的任务运行进度，单位为百分比（%）。通过云数据库HBase控制台发起的任务，包括变更规格、扩容节点、缩容节点、重启实例，小版本升级等

TaskStatus.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
running: The task is running.
pause: The task is paused.
fail: The task is interrupted.
finish: The task is completed
TaskStatus.description_zh:
running 运行中
pause 任务暂停
fail 任务中断
finish 已完成
